prompts.guard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for a premium original hand-drawn 2D belt scrolling beat-em-up, the visual direction of Streets of Rage 4. A single original humanoid school security android, facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view in every frame, adult human proportions, slightly broad shoulders, forest-green and ivory segmented armor, dark charcoal articulated thighs and calves, orange identification stripe on shoulders, compact helmet with a dark black visor and small amber eye slit, closed fists, practical boots. No human face. Clean confident ink outlines, rich cel-painted shading, restrained highlights, readable silhouette. The SAME exact robot design and body proportions across all poses. An actual animator's locomotion and combat sequence, not unrelated illustrations. Exactly 25 frames in a precise 5-column by 5-row regular grid, read left to right row by row, no margins between equally-sized cells, transparent background throughout. Full body fits in every cell with clear padding. Standing poses share the same camera size and planted foot baseline; torso/pelvis root stays near horizontal center of each cell. NO scaling between frames. Index 0: relaxed fighting guard. Indices 1 to 8: eight successive in-place WALK cycle poses with alternating left and right leg, heel contact, weight acceptance, passing foot, push-off, knees bending and opposing arm swing, both feet visible, planted foot on same baseline, a full complete gait. Indices 9 to 16: eight successive poses of one forceful right straight punch: lower center of gravity, shoulders coil, fist cocks back, torso rotates and drives, full fist extension at contact, follow-through, fist retracts, balanced return to guard. Punch goes to the RIGHT at human chest height, no projectile or magic. Indices 17 and 18: two staggered hurt/recoil poses after being punched. Indices 19 to 22: four progressive knockdown poses, torso tips backward, loses support, hits floor, lies completely down. Indices 23 and 24: kneeling recovery and rising guard. Every grid cell contains exactly ONE full robot pose. Keep detached shadows, glowing effects, ground, labels, text, numbers, UI, backgrounds, gradients and checkerboards out. Output square 2048x2048 or higher, genuinely transparent alpha.

Bold controlled ink contours, sophisticated cel-painted surfaces, sculpted shadows, warm late afternoon sunlight from upper LEFT, cool teal-gray ambient shadow, muted forest green and orange school trim.
